kantoLeaders.name: Brock
kantoLeaders.tips: Grass and Water moves hit hard. Bring Oran Berries and heal before the leader.

kantoLeaders.name: Misty
kantoLeaders.tips: Electric and Grass help. Craft Cerulean Star for her gym map (seagrass needs Shears).

kantoLeaders.name: Lt. Surge
kantoLeaders.tips: Ground types shine. Watch for speed and paralysis.

kantoLeaders.name: Erika
kantoLeaders.tips: Fire, Flying, Ice, and Poison are strong options.

kantoLeaders.name: Koga
kantoLeaders.tips: Psychic and Ground help. Bring status cures.

kantoLeaders.name: Sabrina
kantoLeaders.tips: Dark, Bug, and Ghost pressure her team.

kantoLeaders.name: Blaine
kantoLeaders.tips: Water and Ground are reliable. Prepare for Nether-adjacent biomes.

kantoLeaders.name: Giovanni
kantoLeaders.tips: Water, Grass, and Ice help. Deep Dark is dangerous — go prepared.

kantoLeaders.name: Lorelei
kantoLeaders.tips: Fire, Fighting, Rock, and Steel help. Full heal between rooms.

kantoLeaders.name: Bruno
kantoLeaders.tips: Flying, Psychic, and Fairy are strong answers.

kantoLeaders.name: Agatha
kantoLeaders.tips: Dark and Ghost pressure her. Watch for status.

kantoLeaders.name: Lance
kantoLeaders.tips: Ice and Dragon moves matter. Bring a balanced late-game team.

kantoLeaders.name: Blue
kantoLeaders.tips: Cover many types. Unique drop notes mention Ancient Origin Ball on some packs.
